mapper.select: SELECT * FROM msg_notice WHERE (notice_loop = 1) OR (notice_loop = 2 AND ((NOW() > notice_next_time AND NOW() < notice_end_time) OR (notice_next_time = notice_end_time))) OR notice_loop = 3 ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM msg_notice WHERE NOW() > notice_end_time OR notice_end_time IS NULL
